title: Finite-source replacement of a local cokernel presentation
statement: Let S be a short exact sequence of sheaves of left modules over a finite ring on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with constant first term [def-constructible-constant]. Fix a member U of an etale cover. Suppose a short exact module sequence T with finitely generated first term, an isomorphism from the constant sheaf T_3 to S_3 restricted to U, and a map from the constant sheaf T_2 to S_2 restricted to U commuting with the quotient maps are supplied. Then S_2 restricted to U is the cokernel of a morphism between constant sheaves whose source module is finitely generated [def-constructible-finite].

source.place: Tag 093U, Lemma 18.43.5 extension argument, pushout diagram

proof.text: Apply the proved categorical helper extension_presentation to the restriction of S and the constant sheaf of T. Exactness factors T.f followed by r through S.f as g; the helper proves that (-g,T.f) is a kernel of the epimorphism [S.f,r], hence has cokernel S_2 restricted to U.

Choose a constant model M of S_1. Use upperStarConstantSheafIso and preservation of binary coproducts to identify the biproduct with the constant sheaf of M plus T_2, and transport the cokernel. The source is exactly T_1, finitely generated by hypothesis. No further cover refinement is used.

statement_change.old_statement: A local cokernel presentation over one member of an etale cover can be replaced by one with finitely generated source.
statement_change.what: The original arbitrary-presentation assertion is false. Short exactness alone is vacuous for the middle object (0 -> F -> F). Replace it by the actual categorical pushout step from a lifted module presentation with finite kernel; the caller supplies this data using the finite free local lifting step. No conclusion of the downstream extension theorem changes.
